apps.name: Forever
apps.versionDescription: No build has been published yet. The first run of the iOS workflow replaces this entry with a real version, a real size and a download that works.
apps.localizedDescription:
A private world for two people. The day, messages, plans, memories, promises, letters and the rest, in one app. Forever talks to a server rather than living only on the phone: everything real sits behind an account, and accounts are invitation-only.

SideStore signs this build on your phone with your own Apple ID, so it renews itself every seven days. Notifications do not arrive on a sideloaded build — Apple grants that entitlement only to paid memberships — and everything else works.
